decision: Recommend synchronized smooth stroke for an exploratory demo: half the duration and less pre-separation RMS deformation, but higher calculated peak load than the old baseline. Do not claim lower cutting force or real-tomato validation. Fastest tested motion is close to the force stop; unsynchronized smooth cases rejected.
numerical_limit: At 0.2ms versus 0.1ms, the recommended motion has the same failure bonds and terminal success, but peak load differs by 14.3% and maximum matched-time particle position by 1.74mm. This is approximate-model screening, not precise convergence qualification.
